Name: Liquidity sweep reversal
Entry: Price sweeps equal highs then closes back inside range with displacement candle. Enter on retest of the swept level.
Exit: Stop above sweep wick. Target opposing liquidity pool.
Notes: Works best in ranging regimes. Dies in strong trends.

Name: Order block retest
Entry: Higher timeframe trend intact. Price returns to unmitigated order block and prints bullish confirmation candle.
Exit: Stop below order block low. Target 3R or next FVG fill.
Notes: Requires confirmation candle — early entry is the known failure mode.
